title: Release-train playbook: Dedicated pool elasticity, experiment sprints & OKR mapping
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce an operational release-train playbook that maps Dedicated pool elasticity policies to measurable OKRs and a series of short experiment sprints. Scope: policy matrix for surge and prewarm, decision criteria for fallback to cheaper model variants, experiment templates (A/B for batching/quantization), rollout cadence for canaries across regions, and a runbook for finance/ops to reconcile reservation hedges. Out of scope: infra-level kernel changes and low-level GPU drivers (handled by infra eng).
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc version 0.1 published in Confluence with clear policy matrix (surge, prewarm, fallback) and owner for each cell
Three experiment templates added to the experiments repo (latency-first, cost-first, hybrid) with run instructions and expected metrics
OKRs defined and mapped to playbook actions (2 leading indicators, 2 lagging metrics) and added to PM dashboard
Launch checklist for a single pool release-train completed and validated in a dry-run with SRE and Finance
Rollout cadence and rollback criteria agreed and signed off by Eng, SRE, and Finance
